ශී ලංකා පජාතාන්තික සමාජවාදී ජනරජෙය් ගැසට් පතය

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT, (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 Reference No.: WA/18/81/2007. I hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7, of Land Acquisition Act that the Government intends to acquire the following lands which are required for a public purpose. The land allotments of land described below in total extent of 0.6774 Hectare, shown as 2 and 3 in the Preliminary Plan No. Gam 3014 dated of 22.05.2008 prepared by Surveyor General situated in the Ragam Paththuwa Minor Division in the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 168 B, Dickowita in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Wattala in te District of Gampaha, in Western Province and bouned as follows. (Lot No. 1 has been amended as Lot 3 and 4 also Lot 4 is disowned) 1. Lot No. 02
Name of the Land: —: C.S.Watta or K.K.Mahadewan Watta or Jawa’s Watta; Description: waste land; Claimant:Not known; Extent: 0.0003 Hectare.

2. Lot No. 03 Name of the Land: C.S.Watta or K.K.Mahadewan Watta or Jawa’s Watta; Description: Garden and waste land; Claimant: state; Original Climant: Devendra Mahadewan, No.65/19, Chittambalam A.Gardiner Mawatha, Colombo-02; Extent: 0.6771 Hectare. All persons interested in the aforesaid lands are hereby required to appear personally or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at the Divisional Secretary’s Office, on the 31st day of August 2016 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 31st day of August, 2016 the nature of their interest in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said lands, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. W. G. PREMALAL, Divisional Secretary, Wattala. Divisional Secretariat, Wattala, 2nd August, 2016. 08 - 528
